annotations.title: Create a Microsoft image ad from a render (paused)

description: Turn a Hermoso render, or the user’s own picture (any https URL, or a file via upload_file), into a Microsoft Advertising IMAGE ad: a responsive ad on the Microsoft Audience Network (an Audience campaign) or a multimedia ad on Search. One imageUrl is centre-cropped to the 1.91:1 and 1:1 pictures Microsoft requires (or pass images{landscape, square, logo}), uploaded, and the ad is built PAUSED and read back with its pictures. businessName ≤25, 1–15 headlines ≤30, 1–5 longHeadlines ≤90, 1–5 descriptions ≤90. Search multimedia ads get a callToAction button (default LearnMore); Audience ads have none. videoIds attach videos from upload_microsoft_ads_video. Creating it Active in a live ad group needs confirm:true. Free.

adAccountId.description: Microsoft ad account id — omit to use the single shared account

adGroupId.description: ad group to place the image ad in

businessName.description: business name shown on the ad, up to 25 characters

callToAction.description: Search multimedia ads only, e.g. LearnMore, ShopNow, SignUp

confirm.description: true required to create the ad Active in a live ad group

finalUrls.description: landing page URL(s) the ad sends people to

imageUrl.description: one picture, cut to both shapes for you

images.description: pictures by shape: {landscape, square, logo} URLs, instead of imageUrl

longHeadlines.description: 1-5 long headlines, up to 90 characters each

videoIds.description: video ids from upload_microsoft_ads_video to attach

videoSubType.description: aspect ratio of the attached video: 16x9, 5x4, 1x1, 4x5 or 9x16
